subject.title: fix(ui): show workspace context in dashboard header

question: Should maintainers land a focused active-agent plus workspace breadcrumb in the current Control UI shell and close the broader linked issue, or require a different persistent context surface before merge?
rationale: Current main still lacks persistent workspace header context, but the branch conflicts with the new shell architecture and another open draft proposes removing breadcrumbs, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard context contract.

options.title: Land Focused Context After Rebase
options.body: Adapt this breadcrumb to the current shell, refresh browser proof/checks, and close the linked issue for the core visibility slice while tracking optional switcher/toast/prefix work separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to cover switch feedback and stronger live-target proof before the linked issue can close.

options.title: Choose Another Surface
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide that the no-breadcrumb shell direction should carry active-agent/workspace certainty somewhere else.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Context After Rebase
recommendation.body: Adapt this breadcrumb to the current shell, refresh browser proof/checks, and close the linked issue for the core visibility slice while tracking optional switcher/toast/prefix work separately.
